items.title: Report the Adams County sales and use tax
items.description: Wisconsin imposes a 0.5% county sales and use tax in Adams County on taxable retail sales, licenses, leases, rentals and taxable services. Retailers collect and remit it with the Wisconsin sales and use tax return; sourcing and exemptions follow the Department of Revenue's current guidance.
items.deadline: On the assigned Wisconsin sales and use tax filing schedule

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register; the tax is the amount the return reports.

penalty.note: $20 late-filing fee on a delinquent return plus interest of 1.5% a month; a return the department estimates carries a 25% penalty (Wis. Stat. 77.60).

note: Adams County sales and use tax is confirmed by the Wisconsin Department of Revenue; other county-level business duties were not checked.
